title: Plane
summary: Plane's official MCP server, reached at its hosted endpoint with a personal access token.
description: makeplane/plane-mcp-server 0.3.5 (MIT), reached at Plane's hosted streamable-HTTP endpoint https://mcp.plane.so/http/api-key/mcp with `Authorization: Bearer <token>` and `X-Workspace-slug` headers; nothing is installed. The local stdio package (`uvx plane-mcp-server`, PyPI) follows with the python runtime (MK1). Each of the 30 tools takes an `action`, and a tool's risk is its worst action, so most are destructive. Plane publishes no server.json, so the embedded one is written from the README.
